setup: apt-get update -qq >/dev/null 2>&1 && apt-get install -y -qq git ca-certificates >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo 'WARN: apt install git failed (source clone check will fail)'
export PYTHONUTF8=1 LANG=C.UTF-8 && python3 --version && python3 -m pip --version
commands: export PYTHONUTF8=1 LANG=C.UTF-8; mkdir -p /work; cd /work; if python3 -m pip install --upgrade humanize >/work/c1.log 2>&1 && python3 -c "import humanize" 2>>/work/c1.log; then echo "CLAIM c1: PASS 'python3 -m pip install --upgrade humanize' from PyPI succeeded and import humanize works (version $(python3 -c 'import humanize;print(humanize.__version__)'))"; else echo "CLAIM c1: FAIL pip install from PyPI or import failed: $(grep -iE 'error|could not|no matching' /work/c1.log | tail -n1)"; fi

export PYTHONUTF8=1 LANG=C.UTF-8; cd /work; if git clone https://github.com/python-humanize/humanize /work/humanize >/work/c2.log 2>&1 && cd /work/humanize && python3 -m pip install -e . >>/work/c2.log 2>&1 && python3 -c "import humanize,sys; p=humanize.__file__; sys.exit(0 if '/work/humanize' in p else 1)" 2>>/work/c2.log; then echo "CLAIM c2: PASS git clone + 'python3 -m pip install -e .' succeeded; humanize imports from $(python3 -c 'import humanize;print(humanize.__file__)') at commit $(git -C /work/humanize rev-parse --short HEAD)"; else echo "CLAIM c2: FAIL clone or editable install failed: $(grep -iE 'error|fatal|could not' /work/c2.log | tail -n1)"; fi

export PYTHONUTF8=1 LANG=C.UTF-8; cd /work; python3 -c 'import re,json,sys,urllib.request
from importlib import metadata
badge=False
try:
    t=open("/work/humanize/README.md",encoding="utf-8").read()
    badge="img.shields.io/pypi/pyversions/humanize" in t
except Exception as e:
    t=""
rp_local=None
try:
    rp_local=metadata.metadata("humanize").get("Requires-Python")
except Exception as e:
    pass
rp_pypi=None
try:
    d=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("https://pypi.org/pypi/humanize/json",timeout=20))
    rp_pypi=d["info"].get("requires_python")
except Exception as e:
    rp_pypi="unreachable:%s"%e.__class__.__name__
ok=badge and (rp_pypi==">=3.10" or (rp_pypi and rp_pypi.startswith("unreachable") and rp_local==">=3.10"))
print("CLAIM c3: %s README pyversions badge present=%s; pypi.org requires_python=%r; installed metadata Requires-Python=%r" % ("PASS" if ok else "FAIL", badge, rp_pypi, rp_local))'

export PYTHONUTF8=1 LANG=C.UTF-8; cd /work; python3 -c 'import datetime as dt
try:
    import humanize
except Exception as e:
    for c in ["c4","c5","c6","c7","c8","c9","c10"]:
        print("CLAIM %s: FAIL humanize not importable: %r" % (c,e))
    raise SystemExit(0)
def chk(cid, desc, fn, exp):
    try:
        got=fn()
        print("CLAIM %s: %s %s -> %r (expected %r)" % (cid, "PASS" if got==exp else "FAIL", desc, got, exp))
    except Exception as e:
        print("CLAIM %s: FAIL %s raised %r" % (cid, desc, e))
chk("c4","intcomma(12345)",lambda: humanize.intcomma(12345),"12,345")
chk("c5","intword(123455913)",lambda: humanize.intword(123455913),"123.5 million")
chk("c6","naturaldelta(timedelta(seconds=1001))",lambda: humanize.naturaldelta(dt.timedelta(seconds=1001)),"16 minutes")
chk("c7","naturalsize(1_000_000) / binary=True",lambda: (humanize.naturalsize(1_000_000), humanize.naturalsize(1_000_000, binary=True)),("1.0 MB","976.6 KiB"))
chk("c8","fractional(1/3)",lambda: humanize.fractional(1/3),"1/3")
chk("c9","scientific(0.3)",lambda: humanize.scientific(0.3),"3.00 x 10⁻¹")
def ru():
    a=humanize.naturaltime(dt.timedelta(seconds=3))
    humanize.i18n.activate("ru_RU")
    b=humanize.naturaltime(dt.timedelta(seconds=3))
    humanize.i18n.deactivate()
    c=humanize.naturaltime(dt.timedelta(seconds=3))
    return (a,b,c)
chk("c10","naturaltime(3s) before / after activate(ru_RU) / after deactivate()",ru,("3 seconds ago","3 секунды назад","3 seconds ago"))'
